import re
s=open('scripts/build-exec-image.sh').read()
body=s[s.index('cmd_verify()'):s.index('push_token()')]
tools="bash ls find diff grep sed gawk tar gzip bzip2 xz zip unzip git python3 node jq bc file less tree rg sqlite3 tesseract pdftotext zbarimg".split()
dirs="/workspace /workspace/outbox /mnt /src".split()
explicit=len(re.findall(r'^\s*check ', body, re.M))
print("tools",len(tools),"dirs",len(dirs),"explicit check lines",explicit)
print("total", len(tools)+len(dirs)+explicit-2)  # the two loop 'check' lines counted once each
